title: Review outcomes from merged PR bodies

story.i_want_to: see each merged PR's review findings by severity and disposition, and its counted rounds
story.so_that: a PR merged with no counted review round, or with unfixed findings, is visible without reading PR bodies by hand

rationale: loopctl#1014 audit question: review rounds per PR. On 2026-10-29 HCB#3260 merged with no counted round.

acceptance_criteria.description: A merged pull request on a repo with an intake source enqueues one Oban job (unique on tenant, repo, PR number) that reads the PR body through the tenant's GitHub token and parses its ## Review findings section in the format bin/review-dispositions.py --render prints: one row per finding with disposition, file, line and severity.

A new tenant-scoped table pr_review_outcomes stores (source_id, repo, pr_number, merged_at, merge_sha, findings JSON, has_review_section), unique on (tenant_id, repo, pr_number); a re-run replaces the row.
Round counts come from ledger rows of kind review_round (US-50.1) keyed by repo and PR; a merged PR with no review_round row is reported as merged_without_counted_round.

A body with no section, or a line the parser cannot read, is stored with has_review_section false or the line under unparsed; the job never fails on body content. A GitHub error retries with backoff and never blocks the intake webhook.
Tenant isolation: tenant B never reads tenant A's outcomes.

test_cases.name: parse a rendered section
preconditions: a body rendered by review-dispositions.py with three findings
expected_results: three findings with disposition, file, line, severity

test_cases.name: no section and no round
preconditions: a merged PR body without the section

technical_notes: The render format is claude-config bin/review-dispositions.py; copy its vocabulary into a module attribute and pin it with a fixture taken from a real merged PR body.
GitHub calls go through the existing forge behaviour on the tenant's own token (#936).
